tool.name: recalls_search_consumer
tool.description: Returns US Consumer Product Safety Commission recalls of consumer products such as toys, strollers and appliances (recall number, title, product, hazard, date, firm, link), at most 25 records, newest first. Use when asked whether a consumer product has been recalled. Give at least one of product, firm or date_from. An empty list means no matching records. Do not use for food (use recalls_search_food) or drugs (use recalls_search_drug).

product.description: Words from the product name, for example a toy or appliance type. One of product, firm, date_from is required.

firm.description: Name of the manufacturer, for example a brand owner. One of product, firm, date_from is required.

date_from.description: Earliest recall date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. One of product, firm, date_from is required.

date_to.description: Latest recall date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Optional, and not enough on its own.

hazard.description: First hazard described by the CPSC.

firm.description: First manufacturer, as the CPSC prints it.

body.Title: Peony Design Recalls Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard

Products.Name: Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags

Hazards.Name: The snap can detach from the recalled bibs and stroller bags, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a choking hazard to young children.

Manufacturers.Name: Peony Design Co., of Howell, MI

body.Title: BABESIDE Doll and Stroller Children's Toys Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard; Violate Small Parts Ban; Sold on Amazon by HYBDOLLS

Hazards.Name: The recalled toys violate the small parts ban because they are intended for children under three and the small pacifier poses a deadly choking hazard to young children. In addition, the eyes on the plush bear can detach, also posing a choking hazard.

Manufacturers.Name: Huizhou Huitong Crafts Co. Ltd., of China

body.Title: Joolz Recalls Aer2 Car Seat Adapters for Strollers Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard

Products.Name: Joolz Aer2 Car Seat Adapters for Joolz Aer 2 Stroller

Hazards.Name: The recalled car seat adapters can fail to properly attach to the stroller, which may allow the car seat to fall, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.
